Media Wall Plastering in Wishaw and Glasgow

Darren plasters media walls and built-in shelving across Wishaw, Motherwell, Glasgow, North Lanarkshire and the Central Belt. Most media walls take 1 to 2 days, because of the detail round the TV, the fire and the shelves.

A Home Office Shelving Wall

The video and the slider show the same wall: plastered first, with every recess and corner kept sharp, then painted dark and lit from inside the shelves.

BeforeAfter

Why the Detail Takes Time

Media walls can be challenging because of the detail: recesses for the TV and fire, shelves, and corners that all have to line up. That is why most take 1 to 2 days.

"Done 2 separate jobs for me plastered a media wall and also plastered a wall and ceiling"

Amarjit, Google

A Venetian Finish on a Media Wall

A media wall does not have to be painted. The one above the long inset fire in the gallery has a textured plaster finish instead. See the Venetian plaster page for the styles.
